notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.

event.text: Please call 911 now, or get to an emergency department immediately — do not drive yourself. Brief slurred speech with facial droop that resolves can still be a warning of stroke, and stroke risk can be substantial soon after such an episode, so urgent emergency assessment is needed even though you feel normal now. If symptoms return while waiting, tell the dispatcher right away.
